title: Conditional κ = 0.003898226579820971 at ToikY’s #8076 recurring budget
body:
## Conditional signed result

At the same complete recurring log₂ C of 318,291,900 and maximum native height of 524,288 as ToikY’s #8076, the combined construction gives **κ = 0.003898226579820971**. It exceeds #8076’s exact directed stopped upper by **6334499898761145463273 / 2138306510848000000000000000000**, leaves 0.000001773420179029 to 0.0039, and reduces the entry conversion from 518 to 516 bits. The first terminal header drops from 2^1,154,447 + 4 to 2^1,151,157 + 4. The installed heights are (8192, 118919, 524288; Gaussian 499284). The fixed serial setup remains below 2^228.

The new proof integrates the actual occupied Gaussian receiver suffix over the entire matched calendar. Adjacent band phases telescope after integration by parts, allowing six columns of reserve with explicit late and unmatched debits. The independent checker reconstructs a real 6,117-bit grant that has 16 spare axes at six columns and fails at four. The resulting Gaussian debit is 125645/1048576. Combining it with #8073’s ordinary debit 11204/8192 gives κ = 0.003898222531555482 at recurring log₂ C 318291611 and heights (8192, 124612, 524288; Gaussian 491002). A companion eight-column witness keeps the predecessor’s reserve. The integer cap theorem checks one through seven ordinary stages in the stated fixed-price family.

The same six-column price combined with #8076’s independently checked ordinary debit 11178/8192 gives the headline result. A reciprocal tangent argument and directed grid checks give the exact stopped crossing for one to seven stages within this tariff family. Lowering the recurring cap by one makes the booked composite rate unattainable in that family.

This refined task prices occupied calendar suffixes and fixes the complete recurring cap. The public comparison in the addendum separately traces the 15 #8076 source blobs.

Run `python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-integrated-gaussian-suffix`. All 14 scientific scopes on the #8076 composition passed, including independent pricing, actual ownership and cutoff, ordinary stage seams, both raw physical widths, true exterior and nonzero nested returns, signed products with dirty restoration, setup and deliberate owner corruption. Seven scopes also passed on a fresh extraction. The #8076 archive is `bacfc6ec44616063eae1584e6af07a1dbbfaf7948df1745bc059aa4510c7c9a0` and its qualification receipt is `38d1ea88e5f95ce80ac87f8b62204e6f7db82adaa5b0c80dbe106803c30683ff`. The #8073 archive is `1ffaf4eed67cfe2271820bc94d62721573ff715829c829c5d9936b561eacb270`. The combined registered wrapper has a 1,200-second budget. Individual local runs and the clean source controls are documented in EVIDENCE.md. Hosted replay is reported separately.

The all-size result assumes signed native action on all columns, owned allocation and erasure, uniform chronological mixed compilation, fixed-alphabet tape movement and precision, and analytic recovery. Physical execution uses finite fixtures. Clear1nsight used OpenAI Codex Astra and Terra for the proof, mathematical checks and replay. Source notices preserve predecessor credit.
